title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How might post-training techniques like cascade RL redefine the boundaries of LLM capabilities?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Nemotron-Cascade 2 uses multi-domain on-policy distillation to boost reasoning and agentic behavior in a 30B MoE model.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But such power raises risks—like over-reliance on AI in critical systems or amplification of biases in training data.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are focusing on transparency, safety layers, and open-sourcing training pipelines to mitigate these risks.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: I see a future where AI like Nemotron-Cascade 2 supports global problem-solving, from climate modeling to personalized education.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of AI lies in balancing innovation with responsibility—shaping a smarter, more ethical world.

video_cue: A visual of AI agents collaborating across domains, from medical diagnostics to space exploration, with clear ethical guardrails in place.
